estimand: Incremental probability of a visit within two weeks from assignment to Mens E-Mail versus No E-Mail, in the retained historical experiment population

excluded_features.history_segment: Redundant banding of included historical spend
excluded_features.segment: Treatment assignment, not a pre-treatment predictor

split: 60% training, 20% validation, 20% test; fixed random seed, stratified by assignment only, never by outcomes
model_selection: Largest validation Horvitz-Thompson policy gain at 40% capacity among three pre-specified uplift candidates; ties use listed model order
baselines: Response ranking from training treated-arm logistic regression
Expected random targeting at the same capacity
test_protocol: Freeze validation winner; do not refit or tune on test. Rank all eligible test records without consulting their assignment or outcomes. 40% is confirmatory; other displayed capacities are exploratory.
uncertainty: 2000 paired nonparametric bootstrap draws over test records, fixed fitted scores and selection masks; intervals exclude training/model-selection uncertainty and are pointwise, not simultaneous
secondary_protocol: Evaluate conversion and spend under the visit-selected policy; no secondary model fitting or selection; exploratory only
claims: Offline evaluation only. No realised revenue, deployed campaign savings, individual causal labels, or guarantee of future performance.
